description: This pie chart compares the distribution of task types across two datasets, labeled (a) and (b). The chart consists of two separate pie charts, each with six slices representing different task categories. In chart (a), the slices are labeled “this,” “to,” “in,” “equilibrium,” “consatant,” and an unlabeled category, and are colored light blue, light green, light orange, light brown, light red, and dark blue respectively. The proportions shown are 9%, 7%, 31%, 15%, 17%, and 21%. In chart (b), the slices are labeled “this,” “to,” “in,” “equilibrium,” “consatant,” and an unlabeled category, and are colored light yellow, light green, light orange, light brown, light red, and dark blue respectively. The proportions shown are 19%, 27%, 38%, 15%, 19%, and 2%. Percentage labels are displayed inside each slice of both charts. The slices in each chart appear to be ordered from largest to smallest proportion. A legend is included at the top of the image, associating symbols with the task labels.
